title: Departure Board
description:
A fictional OSINT exercise provides these public artifacts from a synthetic persona:

```
12:02 — "Early flight from CMN, coffee first."
12:05 — Photo caption: "Maroc Telecom wifi is reliable today."
12:11 — Post tagged: Casablanca, Morocco
```

The lab asks for the IATA airport code visible in the persona's own post.
objective: Submit the three-letter IATA code as HC{CODE}.

hints.text: The airport code is already present in the first post.
